title: Split oversized files by concern
outcome: Oversized production and test files are split along cohesive concern boundaries without behavior changes, reducing context cost, grep density, review-diff size, and merge friction.
acceptance: A Greg-approved split map uses existing partial-class/module patterns and preserves public and internal behavior.
High-contention files have stable ownership boundaries suitable for concurrent agent work.
Pure-move slices pass the full repository gates and receive an adversarial review that includes moved-code inspection.
